newsitem.title: UK: Siemens prices euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.
newsitem.headline: Siemens prices euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.

text.p: Siemens Coordination Center SA has priced its three 10-year euro Eurobonds, in French francs, guilders and marks, J.P. Morgan said on Tuesday as joint lead manager on all three deals guaranteed by Siemens AG.
All three deals will be redenominated in euros after EMU after which they will be fungible and merged to create a jumbo euro Eurobond.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is also joint lead manager on all three deals. ABN AMRO Hoare Govett is joint lead on guilders and Paribas on francs.
